KA SHNONG LAITKYNSEW.
Ka shnong Laitkynsew ka don ha thaifi ri War Sheila. Ka ia dei
pud bad ka shnong Nongwar (Shelia Confederacy), Nongkroh, Sohsarat
bad Tyrna (Sirdarships). Kiba kham bun eh ki nongshong shnong kidei
kiba ka na hima Khadsawphra, na ki thaih Mawiang bad katto katne
kiba ia shongkha shongman na la ki thaih ki thaih.
Ha ka jingphetwir na kata ka thma hyndai, ki War ki la shu ai ei
sngewbha ia ki nongphetwir ba kin shong kin sah ha tnum jong u wei
u lum kyntoit ba la ker sawdong da ki khlaw tang ban ioh ban thoh
diengiap, dieng iing dieng sem, ban rep ban hang.
Halor jong uta u lum ki mih ki phlang ba jyrngam, ki kdaittah ki
kdaitot. Ha ki sharing ki ieng ki diengsning, ki diengngan, ki dieng
sohstap, ki diengsohot, ki diengsong, ki diengbai bad ki hajar jait ki
dieng ba ju kynrei ha ri War. Ki don ruh kiwei pat ki jait dieng ba ju
pynmih ia ki soh bam rneng kum ki sohkhawiong, sohjadaw, soh
khyllung, sohkhlot, sohlapong, sohshiat, soheitblang, kwai sohlaper,
soh tympew. bym lah shuh ban jer lut hangnu.
Ha ki v.'oh duid bad ki wah rit ki shong buiiai ki shersyngkai, ki
sherionu, ki tham, ki atiymprong, ki dohthlilum, ki japieh, ki khalynjri, ki
khasaw dap tda. Ka briew ki ju leit tong tyrsong, ki ju leit khwai khamtam
ha ki por synrai ban ioh shet jyntah lang bad ki jhur lam byrjew kum u
hurdohmaw ba haba bam ja ka shu syntuid ka ja na u pdot sha kpoh
ar pliang lai pliang kynton, ba la phngian haduh ban da pisa da lynga
ka kpoh kat ban da kyllan umphniangbam tang ban sngew jynsur.
Ha ki hali ha ki pynthor ki briew naduh ka por noh synrai khamtam
ba la dep ot kba ki thung ki tyrso, ki kubi. ki phul kubi, ki phan lem bad
kiwei kiwei de ki jhur ba long jyntah. Ki bam ia lade, ki die ha ki hat
shnong, bad ki pynkiew jhur ruh wat haduh iewbah Sohra.

Ki thung ruh ia u phan myngngor, u phan lieh, u phan sawlia, u
phan dieng lem baroh kiwei ki Jait phan. Ka sboh ia ki jhur ki ai da ka eit
masi ba ioh na kito kiba ri masi kiba ai dud pyndap ia kito ki sh.nong kiba
marjan. Hynrei ka sboh kaba kham bun hi ki ioh na kaba thang bun.
Ha ba thung ia u phan shynreh pat ki ju leit wad na khlaw ia ki
diengtiai ba la lap bad ba la pyut ka ja tlai baroh hapoh. Ki khet lyngkhot
ia ka diengtiai ba la pyut bad ba la long kum ka ksing. Ka jingjrong jong
kawei ka lyngkhot kat ba mang. Kum ha khohsiew, ha syngkai ha
sohpet ne ha sohbuifi. Ki pyndap khyndew bad sboh ia ka ksing mam.
Haba la pynieng ia kane ka ksing ha ka jaka ban ioh pynshaniah, ne
ha trai dieng. Ki sa thung ia u symbai phan shynreh. U phan shynreh
u san arsut na khlieh sha trai. Ki briew kiba la ju mlien ki antad tip thik
thik ba u phan shynreh ba la thung kat kum ka jingjrong ki ksing la ha
khohsiew, syngkai, sohpet ne sohbuih u la shei ha sla khyndew namar
ba u phan shynreh urn Ju iap u symbai. U mih shi mih ynda la dei por
man la ka snem. Haba ki la antad thik thik ba u phan u la shei khyndew
ki sa thiieh arliang ia ka ksing. Ki sei noh ia u phan u ba Jrong mlun. la
ka ksing tlai pat ki sa teh pynlong ksing biang ban ioh thung phan
shynreh pat hadien ha bud. Kumne ki Ju leh ruh ia ki dieng baroh kiba
long ksing.
Kiba kham bun ki briew Jong ka shnong Laitkynsew ki dei kiba
khaii pateng. Ka shnong hi ka long ha pdeng ki war Sheila, Nongkroh
bad Sohsarat. Ki thied ia ki syiar ki pylleng, ki dohkha ba mih na hat
Majai, Hat Tharia bad Hat Sheila. La shai dang riew u ‘iar nyngkong ki

Jyntah dohkha. la ki snier ba la sdieh pat ki khleh piat, sohmyngken
ban tah Ja.
